answer: Streak multipliers at the ivory tier: each verified epoch multiplies stake weight by 1.15^s. The dune of fresh wallets earns 1.0x, while a 20-epoch streak yields 16x. Attackers must forge 20 sequential proofs across distinct blocks; forking sybils resets every streak to zero. Cost scales linearly but influence superlinearly, so 100 fresh IDs underweight one honest veteran. Works because streak continuity is unforgeable without sustained real work.
